item.text:
**7B.4 — Research Note**
Verdict: **mixed, leaning no clear 2024 proof of direct enrichment**. I found several 2024 signals of anti-patronage or rule-based management, but I did **not** find a 2024 source that directly proves Shehbaz Sharif or a close family member newly profited from office via a specific asset, contract, bribe, or hidden conflict. The strongest direct profit allegations remain **pre-2024** background material.

**2024 Evidence Favouring Separation**
- [Pakistan IMF reaches agreement on economic policies for 37-month EFF](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/12/pr-24273-pakistan-imf-reaches-agreement-on-economic-policies-for-37-month-eff) | IMF | 2024-07-12 | The program centered on tax-base broadening, SOE reform, stronger competition, and larger BISP/health/education spending. That is the clearest 2024 evidence of a rule-based, anti-rent policy direction rather than office-holder enrichment. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`
- [Pakistan PM to choose banker Aurangzeb as finance minister, sources say](https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-to-choose-banker-aurangzeb-as-finance-minister-sources-say/1996592/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | Sharif chose a career banker for finance instead of a political loyalist. That supports competence-seeking management and weakens a pure patronage reading. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`
- [PM forms new economic advisory council without Dar, Aurangzeb](https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1190715-pm-forms-new-economic-advisory-council-without-dar-aurangzeb) | The News | 2024-05-19 | He created a council of economists, technocrats, and business figures to guide policy. That is evidence of some separation from narrow political favoritism in economic decision-making. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`
- [PM Shehbaz directs full digitalization of social welfare payments under BISP](https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/) | APP | 2024-03-18 | Digital wallets were pushed to reduce leakage, delay, and discretion in welfare delivery. This is a concrete anti-patronage reform. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`, `6B.8`
- [BISP assistance goes to poor and deserving people regardless of political affiliation](https://www.bisp.gov.pk/NewsDetail/MjU0NDA1ZTItM2NiOC00NGE4ZTItNGFiZTY4ZDFiZGFj) | BISP | 2024-05-23 | BISP publicly described its aid as nonpartisan and transparent. That is direct evidence against using welfare as a loyalty vehicle. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.8`
- [Govt unveils broader privatisation plan for state-owned enterprises](https://www.dawn.com/news/1833439/govt-unveils-broader-privatisation-plan-for-state-owned-enterprises) | Reuters via Dawn | 2024-05-14 | Sharif announced privatization of most SOEs and said the government should not do business itself. That cuts against public office being used to maintain state-linked rents. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`
- [PM says 5 IPPs to revisit contracts as Hub Power’s govt deal ends prematurely](https://www.dawn.com/news/1864298/govt-unveils-broader-privatisation-plan-for-state-owned-enterprises) | Reuters via Dawn | 2024-10-10 | The government renegotiated costly power contracts to reduce tariffs and save about Rs60 billion a year. That looks more like cost-cutting for households than private enrichment through energy contracts. | IDs: `7B.4`, `6B.10`, `7B.3`
- [PM orders action against sugar mills](https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailImage.php?StoryImage=20_11_2024_009_003) | Dawn ePaper | 2024-11-20 | Sharif ordered FBR, FIA, and IB action against tax fraud and hoarding in the sugar sector, a politically sensitive industry. That is weak but real counterevidence to the idea that he was protecting sugar-industry rents. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`

**2024 Evidence Cutting Against Clean Separation**
- [Most cabinet choices were still long-time PML-N/PDM hands](https://www.dawn.com/news/1821157) | Dawn | 2024-03-01 | The cabinet still leaned heavily on old political hands, which weakens the case for a clean technocratic break from patronage. This is indirect, but it matters because patronage-heavy staffing makes hidden conflicts easier to hide. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`
- [Sharif retained direct control over a key economic coordination body](https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967) | Dawn | 2024-06-15 | He kept hands-on control over ECNEC instead of fully delegating to the finance minister. That suggests personalized executive management still dominated, rather than a hard separation between office and private interest. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.3`, `6B.10`
- [Pakistan widening crackdown on dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | HRW said pressure on media, opposition, and NGOs deepened self-censorship. This does not prove profit, but it shows a broader secrecy-friendly environment around power. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.1`, `7B.2`
- [Pakistan’s government curbs judiciary’s power after alleged harassment of MPs](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps) | The Guardian | 2024-10-21 | The 26th Amendment weakened judicial independence amid intimidation allegations. That reduces the chance that conflicts of interest would be exposed or checked. | IDs: `7B.4`, `7B.1`, `7B.2`, `7B.3`

**Background Only, Not Counted as 2024 Proof**
- [FIA revives sugar scam probe against Shehbaz](https://www.dawn.com/news/1629537) | Dawn | 2021-05-16 | FIA alleged Rs25bn in accounts linked to the Sharif family’s sugar-business network, cash received on Shehbaz’s behalf, and beneficial use for family members. This is the strongest direct profit allegation I found, but it is pre-2024 background, not a new 2024 finding. | IDs: `7B.4`
- [Shehbaz, sons failed to give trail of Rs16bn in sugar scam](https://www.dawn.com/news/1663101) | Dawn | 2021-11-25 | NAB alleged money laundering through family-owned business entities and front accounts. Again, this is direct enrichment allegation background, but not 2024 proof of a new office-linked gain. | IDs: `7B.4`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find a 2024 source proving a newly exposed asset, bribe, hidden contract benefit, or other fresh enrichment event for Sharif or a close family member.
- The best direct profit-related evidence remains the older FIA/NAB sugar-mill and money-laundering allegations, which are unresolved background rather than 2024 findings.
